title: Fractional Sobolev-type embedding on CR sphere and Heisenberg group
summary: This paper studies critical fractional Sobolev inequalities with lower-order terms on the standard CR sphere $\mathbb S^{2n+1}$. Let $Q=2n+2$, let $s\in(0,1)$, let $1<p<Q$, and let $p_s^*=\frac{Qp}{Q-sp}$. For the inequality $\|u\|_{L^{p_s^*}(\mathbb S^{2n+1})}\le A[u]_{s,p}+B\|u\|_{L^p(\mathbb S^{2n+1})}$, we prove that the admissible lower-order coefficients are exactly $\left[|\mathbb S^{2n+1}|^{-s/Q},\infty\right)$.
